stories.title: Two new industrial units approved at Rhydymwyn estate where fire destroyed building in 2022
stories.summary: A planning officer at Flintshire County Council has approved two industrial units at Antelope Industrial Estate on Denbigh Road, Rhydymwyn, three years after a fire destroyed the site’s largest building. stories.summary: A Coleg Cambria lecturer received a hero’s welcome from students and staff after helping make television history as part of the first choir ever to win Britain’s Got Talent (BGT). stories.title: Zero hours workers could get guaranteed contracts — here is what the consultation proposes
